steps.title: Images in code
steps.body:
**Pillow** (imported as **PIL**) creates and edits images. An **Image** has a **size** (width, height), a **mode** such as **RGB** or **L** (grayscale) and pixels you can read or write.

Call **img.show()** and the image appears in the app's output panel.

steps.title: Creating and drawing
steps.code:
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw

img = Image.new("RGB", (60, 40), "white")
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)
draw.rectangle((5, 5, 30, 25), fill="red")
print(img.size, img.mode)
print(img.getpixel((10, 10)))
img.show()

notes.text: Image.new makes a blank 60 by 40 image.
ImageDraw lets you draw shapes on it.
The rectangle is filled with red.
getpixel reads the color at a point.
show sends the picture to the output panel.

steps.title: Resize, crop, rotate and flip
steps.code:
from PIL import Image

img = Image.new("RGB", (40, 20), "blue")
print(img.resize((20, 10)).size)
print(img.crop((0, 0, 10, 10)).size)
print(img.rotate(90, expand=True).size)
print(img.transpose(Image.Transpose.FLIP_LEFT_RIGHT).size)

notes.text: resize returns a new image of the requested size.
crop takes a box (left, top, right, bottom).
expand=True grows the canvas so nothing is cut off.

steps.title: Modes, pixels and filters
steps.code:
from PIL import Image, ImageFilter

img = Image.new("RGB", (4, 4), (200, 100, 50))
gray = img.convert("L")
print(gray.mode, gray.getpixel((0, 0)))
img.putpixel((0, 0), (0, 255, 0))
print(img.getpixel((0, 0)))
blurred = img.filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(1))
print(blurred.size)

notes.text: Grayscale mixes the channels into one brightness value.

steps.title: Building a gradient with pixels
steps.code:
from PIL import Image

img = Image.new("RGB", (8, 1))
for x in range(8):
    shade = x * 32
    img.putpixel((x, 0), (shade, 0, 255 - shade))
print(img.getpixel((0, 0)), img.getpixel((7, 0)))
img.resize((160, 20), Image.Resampling.NEAREST).show()

notes.text: Compute a color for every column.
Nearest-neighbor resize keeps hard pixel edges.

examples.title: Pillow: Create and Draw
examples.description: Shapes and text on a blank canvas.
examples.code:
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw

img = Image.new("RGB", (200, 120), "#101820")
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)
draw.rectangle((10, 10, 90, 60), fill="tomato", outline="white")
draw.ellipse((110, 20, 190, 100), fill="seagreen")
draw.line((10, 110, 190, 90), fill="gold", width=4)
draw.text((12, 70), "Pillow", fill="white")
print(img.size)
img.show()

examples.title: Pillow: Filters
examples.code:
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFilter

img = Image.new("RGB", (120, 80), "white")
ImageDraw.Draw(img).rectangle((30, 20, 90, 60), fill="navy")
blur = img.filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(4))
edges = img.filter(ImageFilter.FIND_EDGES)
print(blur.size, edges.size)
blur.show()
edges.show()

examples.title: Pillow: Resize and Crop
examples.code:
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw

img = Image.new("RGB", (160, 100), "skyblue")
ImageDraw.Draw(img).ellipse((60, 20, 120, 80), fill="orange")
small = img.resize((80, 50))
cropped = img.crop((50, 10, 130, 90))
print(small.size, cropped.size)
cropped.show()

examples.title: Pillow: Rotate and Flip
examples.code:
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw

img = Image.new("RGB", (120, 60), "white")
ImageDraw.Draw(img).polygon([(10, 50), (60, 10), (110, 50)], fill="purple")
rot = img.rotate(30, expand=True, fillcolor="white")
flip = img.transpose(Image.Transpose.FLIP_TOP_BOTTOM)
mirror = img.transpose(Image.Transpose.FLIP_LEFT_RIGHT)
print(rot.size, flip.size, mirror.size)
rot.show()
flip.show()

examples.title: Pillow: Color Modes
examples.code:
from PIL import Image

img = Image.new("RGB", (160, 40))
for x in range(160):
    for y in range(40):
        img.putpixel((x, y), (x * 255 // 159, 80, 255 - x * 255 // 159))
gray = img.convert("L")
bw = gray.convert("1")
print(img.mode, gray.mode, bw.mode)
img.show()
gray.show()

examples.title: Pillow: Pixel Operations
examples.code:
from PIL import Image

img = Image.new("RGB", (64, 64))
for x in range(64):
    for y in range(64):
        img.putpixel((x, y), ((x ^ y) * 4 % 256, x * 4, y * 4))
print(img.getpixel((10, 20)))
inverted = img.point(lambda v: 255 - v)
print(inverted.getpixel((10, 20)))
img.resize((192, 192), Image.Resampling.NEAREST).show()

examples.title: Mix: NumPy + Matplotlib
examples.description: Compute with NumPy, draw with Matplotlib.
examples.code:
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

t = np.linspace(0, 2 * np.pi, 200)
signal = np.sin(t) + 0.5 * np.sin(3 * t)
plt.plot(t, signal, color="teal")
plt.title("Two harmonics")
plt.show()
print(round(signal.max(), 3))

examples.title: Mix: Pandas + Matplotlib
examples.code:
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

df = pd.DataFrame({"month": ["Jan", "Feb", "Jan", "Feb", "Jan", "Feb"], "shop": ["A", "A", "B", "B", "C", "C"], "sales": [10, 14, 8, 9, 12, 20]})
totals = df.groupby("month")["sales"].sum()
totals.plot(kind="bar", color="slateblue")
plt.title("Sales per month")
plt.show()
print(totals.to_dict())

examples.title: Mix: NumPy + Pillow
examples.description: Turn an array into an image.
examples.code:
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image

x = np.linspace(0, 255, 128)
row = np.tile(x, (64, 1))
rgb = np.stack([row, row[::-1], np.full_like(row, 128)], axis=-1).astype("uint8")
img = Image.fromarray(rgb)
print(img.size, img.mode)
img.show()
